verdict.rationale: Finix docs explicitly cover API-driven seller onboarding (finix-docs-6, finix-docs-9, finix-docs-10), hosted 'Onboarding Forms' to save time building forms (finix-docs-5), platform merchant onboarding (finix-docs-4), and bank account linking via microdeposit verification (finix-docs-35), matching the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit KYC/KYB terminology, explicit terms-acceptance step documentation, and a clearly named embeddable onboarding component (Tokenization Forms cited relate to checkout, not seller onboarding specifically).
